gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i1: Tests that {@link TaiInstant#parse(CharSequence)} rejects malformed text.

The accepted format is the strict {@code {seconds}.{nanosOfSecond}s(TAI)} pattern,

ADDED i2: Each value is malformed in a distinct way, so parsing it must fail:
  • {@code "A.123456789s(TAI)"} - non-numeric seconds part
  • {@code "123.1234567
